faq: Will you edit the Magento core files?
No. Core edits are overwritten at upgrade time and cause trouble later. We work in your theme or a child theme and in layout XML, so your store stays upgrade friendly.
Do you work on a staging copy?
Yes. We ask for a staging site or set one up on your host, make the changes there and send you a link. We deploy to your live store only after you approve.
Which Magento versions do you support?
Magento 2 and Adobe Commerce 2.x, including Luma, Hyva and custom themes. Magento 1 is end of life, so for a Magento 1 store we recommend a migration instead of new edits.
What if my theme is heavily customized?
Send us access to the repository or a copy of the theme folder. We review it before quoting any extra work and tell you plainly if a change would be risky, then suggest a safer way.
